title: Investigate gateway-main heartbeat presence policy on Riley
description: Gateway-main agent still ages to offline while board leads remain online after switching board-scoped MC agents to internal heartbeat target none. Determine whether gateway-main should also use target none, explicit heartbeat check-in, or a different presence policy.

title: Fix Riley Mission Control agent detail on SQLite
description: Agent detail pages on Riley Mission Control fail with 'Agent not found' after the SQLite cutover because agent route/service lookups treat UUID identifiers as strings in a way that is not portable across dialects. Fix the agent API/service path to normalize UUIDs, add regression coverage, and verify the Riley backend serves agent detail successfully.
close_reason: Fixed by normalizing agent UUID lookups for SQLite-compatible agent detail routes, adding regression coverage, and verifying Riley agent detail/activity/boards APIs return 200.

title: Fix Mission Control false-online assignee wake and force delivery on assignment
close_reason: Fixed false-online assignee wake and switched task notifications to deliver immediately.

title: Fix Mission Control template sync AUTH_TOKEN parsing for agent workspaces
Install local Postgres and Redis on Riley
description: Install Homebrew PostgreSQL and Redis on the Riley machine so Mission Control no longer depends on remote 3090 database infrastructure. Verify the services start locally and leave Mission Control unchanged until service health is confirmed.
close_reason: Installed local PostgreSQL 16 and Redis on Riley, migrated Mission Control state from SQLite to local Postgres, repointed the Riley backend to local Postgres/Redis, and verified the ACE Music Lead, Comfy Video Lead, and Riley Gateway agents are all online.

title: Retighten Riley MC agent exec policy after reply path hardening
description: Mission Control board leads on Riley are currently running with OpenClaw exec.security=full so board-chat replies are reliable. Follow up by designing a safer steady-state: either deterministic one-line API execution, stronger generated prompts/runtime helpers, or a policy shape that preserves reply reliability without leaving MC agents on full exec.

title: Add missing Alembic migrations for Mission Control schema drift
description: Fresh PostgreSQL bootstrap on Riley via alembic upgrade head does not create several columns that the current backend code expects: gateways.allow_insecure_tls, gateways.disable_device_pairing, boards.comment_required_for_review, agents.lifecycle_generation, agents.wake_attempts, agents.last_wake_sent_at, agents.checkin_deadline_at, agents.last_provision_error, and activity_events.board_id. Riley required manual ALTER TABLE patches before SQLite->Postgres migration could complete. Add proper migrations so future Postgres bootstraps work without manual schema surgery.

title: Fix Riley Mission Control dashboard fetch failure
description: Dashboard page shows 'Failed to fetch' after the SQLite cutover/reseed. Diagnose the exact failing API call and restore the dashboard on Riley without disturbing the working boards/gateway/agent paths.
close_reason: Dashboard metrics endpoint restored after SQLite cutover

title: Fix bd git hook command mismatch
description: The repo's installed git hooks call 'bd hook', but the current Beads CLI exposes 'bd hooks'. This breaks bd sync, pre-commit, and normal landing workflows unless commits/pushes are forced with --no-verify. Update the hook scripts or CLI invocation so bd sync works normally again.

title: Fix MC board-lead heartbeat target on Riley
close_reason: Board-scoped MC agents now normalize heartbeat target to none, Riley leads were reprovisioned, and targeted tests passed.

title: Reconcile Riley Mission Control clone with upstream after manual hotfixes
description: Riley Mission Control is healthy and reseeded again, but the on-box openclaw-mission-control clone has local drift and manual hotfixes applied directly to restore service. Cleanly reconcile Riley's clone with the pushed upstream repo, preserve the local env/runtime wiring, and verify restart from a clean git state.

title: Riley MC leads hit ZAI glm-5.1 rate-limit loops after model cutover
description: Riley Mission Control lead agents were cut over from zai/glm-4.7 to zai/glm-5.1 on the Z.AI coding endpoint. Config is fixed and gateway reload confirms model=glm-5.1, but embedded lead runs can still enter provider-side rate-limit retries under load. Need to investigate retry/backoff behavior and whether lead-agent traffic should be throttled or routed differently.

title: Restore Riley Mission Control state after SQLite cutover
description: Mission Control is healthy again on Riley after decoupling from the 3090-backed Postgres/Redis path, but the new local SQLite database is empty. Recreate or migrate the Riley gateway record, agent records, and starter boards/board groups on the local DB, and decide whether to keep local SQLite or move to a stable local Postgres/Redis host.
close_reason: Restored Riley Mission Control state on the local SQLite database, recreated the Riley gateway and content/media boards, restored the gateway-main and Comfy lead agent records/tokens, and verified both user and agent API paths against the live Riley backend.

title: Fix Riley Mission Control DB connectivity
close_reason: Fixed by moving Riley Mission Control backend off the unreachable 3090 Postgres/Redis path and restarting it on a local SQLite database. Frontend and backend tunnels now answer again, auth works, and the loading failure is gone.

title: Fix board chat UI stale history and SSE filtering
description: Board chat on the board page can stop at older entries even when newer board-memory chat rows exist. Fix the board page to refetch chat history while open and trust is_chat instead of tags.includes("chat") for streamed rows.
close_reason: Board page now refetches board chat history and trusts is_chat for streamed rows.
